To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we integrated functional miRNA-mRNA interactions with gene expression to infer miRNA-miRNAs interactions, we used the network to characterize the functional roles of MREs to mediate miRNA-miR interactions in prostate cancer, and we identified miRNAs that can be used as biomarkers to diagnose prostate cancer.

we integrated functional miRNA target interactions with gene expression data to infer miRNA-miRNAmiRNA interactions and identified miRNA response elements as a potential mechanism to mediate miRNA-miR-miRNA interactions.

we developed a novel method to identify miRNA-miRNAs interactions that are regulated by MREs, we applied our method to a prostate cancer data set and identified miRNA-1 as a key miRNA, and we identified a set of 11 miRNas that can be used as diagnostic and prognositic biomarkers for prostate cancer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of MRE-mediated miRNA-mRNA interactions and miRNA-miRNAmRNA in prostate cancer progression.
the development and utilization of computational approaches that integrate multiple sources of data and knowledge to gain insight into prostate cancer progression and metastases.
developing and applying systems biology approaches to identify miRNAs and their targets involved in prostate cancer progression and metastatic spread.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this work demonstrates the utility and feasibility of a network analysis of gene expression data as opposed to differential gene expression to identify important miRNAs and their targets that are key players in prostate cancer progression and metastases.
miRNA response elements are a potential source for miRNA-miRNAmiRNA interactions.
this work presents a new approach to integrate miRNA-target interactions and miRNA and mRNA expression to identify miRNA-miRNAs interactions in prostate cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a systematic method to infer miRNA-miRNAs interactions from miRNA and mRNA expression data and we have used this method to find miRNAs that have an impact in prostate cancer.
we developed a network analysis approach to identify key miRNAs and their targets that are important for prostate cancer progression.
miRNA-21, miRNA-221 and miRNA-1 are key regulators of prostate cancer progression and metastatic potential.
The main takeaway from our work is that
miRNAs can be used to identify novel biomarkers for diagnosis and prognosis.
miRNA-miRNAs interactions are important for prostate cancer progression and that miRNA-mRNA interactions are important for miRNA function.
miRNA-miRNAs interactions are important in prostate cancer and that miRNA-9, miRNA-21, and miRNA-221 may be used to predict prostate cancer progression.
